note: Lexical search through txco://search/*, the chassis built-in backed by the bundled Bleve store. /seed ensures a collection and upserts four records; /find queries it with plain language under a metadata filter; /rename updates a record without touching its text; /forget deletes a document by filter. The checks run in order and cover all five ops. Binds localhost → search-demo (the _sys/boot/75 path auto-route also exists for bare `txco dev` use).

checks.name: seed: ensure the collection, upsert four records
ordinary words: a whole sentence finds its record
filter: the team's ticket is hidden from anyone
identifier: TXC-4821 finds the ticket for the team
phrase: the intact clause ranks first
update: rename the parking page without re-indexing its text
delete by filter: forget a whole document
the forgotten document no longer matches
